message.content:
The description is of a shapeless robe with raw, unfinished edges, long sleeves and a hem. That sounds like a costume-type garment, possibly a Halloween costume (e.g., a grim reaper or monk robe) of the sort made from cheap woven polyester. Halloween costumes fall under heading 9505 (festive articles), specifically 9505.90.6000 for other festive articles. Under Note 1(e) to Chapter 61 and Chapter 62, garments of heading 9505 are excluded, and costumes of textile materials are classified in 9505 if they are of flimsy construction (not durable, unfinished seams). The raw, unfinished edges and loose stitching indicate flimsy construction, which points to a costume. Subheading 9505.90.6000 is "Other festive, carnival or other entertainment articles: Other," and the earlier 9505.10 covers Christmas articles. Costumes are generally classified under 9505.90.6000.
